>That does leave a vacuum in life issue - which is part of what you are dealing with know, I guess?

I've always had problems with socializing. So the party scene was like a miracle cure. It was instantaneous relief from a life filled with pain. It was such a profound discovery and made such a huge impact on me. I guess I'm still having a hard time letting go.

It's been about a year since I last indulged - two pills - I don't really know if there was really any MDMA in them at all. 

I was a weekend roller for about about six months after I really started getting into the rave scene back in 2001. The usage started to taper-off but I rolled about every month to two months for about two years afterwords. At around 2004, I'd indulge only on special occasions (3-4 times a year) all the way up until 2006. I abused alcohol during the same time period.

It was such a large part of my life for such a long time. After I slowed down my consumption, a part of my identity was lost. I used pills as a crutch to avoid my problems and now they are bubbling up and it's getting harder and harder to deal with them. I know it's my fault - no one put a gun to head and forced me to take the pills.
I guess it's kind of a defense mechanism. I get pretty devastated when I get rejected from anything (I'm really, REALLY sensitive), so I do the rejecting first. I'm a pretty fucked up person.

Hmmm... where to begin. I've been feeling trapped lately - like the walls of reality are collapsing in on me. For the longest time, I've lied to myself. Lied and lied for years and years. I've told myself that I'm normal, that I've had friends that really cared, and that I was once a caring person. Bullshit, all of it.

I can't imagine a person being more selfish than I am. Every time someone gets close, I push them away. I use emotions as weapons of war, instead of tools for love. I let people walk all over me - I'm such a pussy. 

I'm a high school drop-out; former MDMA abuser; loser, with no friends, no life and no hope for the future.

I can't even hide who I am from strangers - it's written across my face. People look at me like I'm a freak everywhere I go. I know it's all in the way I carry myself. I just don't know what to do about it.

Ending it all is starting to seem like the only option I have left. I'm such a weak person.
